name: Fine Lines
description: Fine lines are small wrinkles that appear around the eyes, mouth, and forehead. They can be a natural part of the aging process but may also result from external factors such as sun exposure, smoking, and dehydration.
symptoms: Small wrinkles around the eyes (crow's feet)
Wrinkles around the mouth and lips
Tiny lines on the forehead and between eyebrows

when_to_consult_doctor: If fine lines are causing significant distress or if you notice rapid development of deeper wrinkles, consult a dermatologist for personalized advice and treatment options.

severity_levels.mild: Visible fine lines around the eyes, mouth, or forehead. No major impact on skin texture.
severity_levels.moderate: More pronounced fine lines with some loss of skin elasticity and texture. May require more intensive treatments for improvement.
severity_levels.severe: Severe fine lines that significantly affect skin texture and may be accompanied by loose or sagging skin. Requires professional treatment.
